facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this. Cầu Ánh Sáng sits inside Grand World Phu Quoc and most visitors never slow down long enough to actually look at it. Lit up at night, the bridge reflects across the water in a way your camera will not be ready for. Go after dark. No crowd. No queue. Just you and the lights. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walking across Cầu Ánh Sáng after dark, lights hitting the water below. This is inside Grand World and almost nobody stops here. Go slow. Worth every second.
